title: A revisited history of cacao domestication in pre-Columbian times revealed by archaeogenomic approaches
version: Scientific Reports 14, 2972, DOI 10.1038/s41598-024-53010-6. Version-of-record article rendered online.
lineage: Archaeogenomics and residues from other vessel assemblages. Several investigators overlap with the Santa Ana-La Florida project.

passages.note: Positive cacao DNA calls include Valdivia and San Jacinto cultural contexts. Table 1 gives broad ranges for the associated cultures. The authors distinguish multiple genetic affinities on the Ecuadorian and Colombian coast. The work does not trace descent from an individual Santa Ana-La Florida sample.
